text: Owner-requested proposal for #5539/#5541, reviewed at v1-development 718a20f1a; no implementation or real-fixture verification performed. Posted detailed comments: https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/5539#issuecomment-5613253182 and https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/5541#issuecomment-5613253422 . Investigate #5541 first: mdbtools skips deleted row slots (0x4000) and maps Id & 0x00FFFFFF to the candidate TDEF page. Deleted catalog rows could explain plausible names pointing to reused pages; hypothesis only, original fixture must be rechecked. Masking does not explain small IDs 26/28. Page-type validation alone cannot fix this: the reported wrong targets are already TDEF pages. Record row liveness/ownership/raw flags and independently compare live catalog and target schemas; retain unresolved associations rather than guessing names. Then implement #5539 in two slices: preserve fixed/variable offsets and distinct row-column metadata currently discarded by the TDEF parser, with bounded Jet3/Jet4 row decoding; then catalog enumeration with source page/row provenance and explicit association status. Descriptor order is not storage order, a concrete unconfirmed lead for Jet4. Verify real Jet3/Jet4 rows with independent expected outputs; retain hashes, provenance, tool versions and sanitized results; add synthetic null/empty/fixed-null/jump-boundary/text/column-order/deleted/malformed regressions. Update requirements traceability, evidence gaps, HZ-data-corruption-01 linkage and CHANGELOG when implementing. Both issues remain open; this proposal does not establish stale IDs or verified Jet4 support.
